title_sq: Vile ne shitje tek Kodra Diellit 2
description_sq:
Kodra Diellit 2,prane Conadit, disponojm per shitje Vile 2 kateshe, siperfaqe ndertimi 182m2, e mobiluar. E paisur me sistem ngrohje ftohje qendrore, sistem kamerash, kushte bashkohore te kohes, me parkim, ideale per shoqata te huaj, zyra ose ambjente. Vila ka akses privat, me hyrje nga veranda e gjelberuar, ku ne katin e pare gjendet salloni sebashku me aneksin e gatimit, si edhe nje tualet. Ne katin e dyte ndodhen 3 dhoma gjumi (Dhoma e ciftit me tualet brenda, si edhe garderobe, dhoma e dyte me krevat dopio, si edhe dhoma e trete me krevat trecereksh, e perdorshme edhe si garderobe/studio). Po ne kete kate eshte edhe tualeti i trete me vaske. Jepet si ne foto.
Aktualisht eshte e dhene me qera, kontrat 1 vjecare.
Shitet 340.000 Euro.
title_en: Villa for sale at Kodra Diellit 2
description_en: Kodra Diellit 2, near Conad, we have for sale a 2-storey villa, construction area 182m2, furnished. Equipped with a central heating and cooling system, camera system, simultaneous weather conditions, with parking, ideal for foreign associations, offices or premises. The villa has private access, with entrance from the green veranda, where on the first floor there is a living room together with a kitchen annex, as well as a toilet. On the second floor there are 3 bedrooms (a double bedroom with a bathroom inside, as well as a wardrobe, the second bedroom with a double bed, as well as the third bedroom with a triple bed, which can also be used as a wardrobe/studio). Yes, on this floor there is also the third toilet with a bathtub. It is given as in the photo. It is currently rented, 1 year contract. For sale 340,000 Euros.
